conditions.description: Communal or CBD sites - limits spurious components
conditions.text: When the transmitter is coupled to an antenna the level of all discrete spurious components caused by the transmitter & measured at the connection to the antenna must not exceed -30 DBM. Broadband noise floor of the transmitter measured at the same point must not exceed -47 DBM in a 16 kHz bandwidth for frequency offsets greater than 300 kHz from the transmit frequency.

conditions.description: Malfunction / interference
conditions.text: In the event of a malfunction or interference being caused to other services, termination of transmissions must be promptly effected. Where access to the repeater is difficult, termination of transmissions must be achievable by remote switching.

conditions.description: Cavity filter - transmitter/antenna
conditions.text: An efficient cavity filter must be fitted between the transmitter and the antenna.

conditions.description: Cavity filter - receiver/antenna
conditions.text: An efficient cavity filter must be fitted between the receiver and the antenna.

conditions.description: Repeater access
conditions.text: Access to the repeater station must be provided on an unrestricted basis to any licensee in the service.

conditions.description: Conditions applicable to amateur repeater stations
conditions.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Amateur Repeater station(s) authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Amateur Licence) Determination. Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

conditions.description: Charges/continuous service/transmission restriction
conditions.text: 1. The station must produce a continuous service. 2. No charges may be imposed by the licensee or their agent for the use of the repeater facility. 3. No transmission shall be made in the absence of a received signal. The transmitter must not be able to lock-on due to a malfunction.

conditions.text: This licence has been issued as part of an interim licensing arrangement to facilitate the use of 5055-5065 MHz for RPAS CNPC. Depending on the outcome of future planning and licensing considerations for the band, the ACMA may seek to amend the frequency or other operating parameters of the licence to align with longer-term planning arrangements.
The licensee should ensure that the notional geographic service area for LoS operation is confined to a 200 km radius from the registered aeronautical station location.

The service authorised by this licence may operate using aggregated channels within the range 5055�5065 MHz for the purpose of RPAS payload communications. This service must not cause interference to and must accept interference from licensed services operating in accordance with RALI MS48.

For the purposes of interference management, this licence is issued on a first-in-time basis. New licensees shall not claim protection from any existing licensed RPAS CNPC operation nor shall cause any interference to them.

This licence has been issued for a 1-year duration and will not be automatically invoiced for renewal. The licensee will need to apply for renewal should they wish to continue operation beyond the expiry date.

conditions.text: This licence has been issued as part of an interim licensing arrangement to facilitate the use of 5055-5065 MHz for RPAS CNPC. Depending on the outcome of future planning and licensing considerations for the band, the ACMA may seek to amend the frequency or other operating parameters of the licence to align with longer-term planning arrangements.
The licensee should ensure that the notional geographic service area for LoS operation is confined to a 200 km radius from the registered aeronautical station location.

The service authorised by this licence may operate using aggregated channels within the range 5055�5065 MHz for the purpose of RPAS payload communications. This service must not cause interference to and must accept interference from licensed services operating in accordance with RALI MS48.

For the purposes of interference management, this licence is issued on a first-in-time basis. New licensees shall not claim protection from any existing licensed RPAS CNPC operation nor shall cause any interference to them.

This licence has been issued for a 1-year duration and will not be automatically invoiced for renewal. The licensee will need to apply for renewal should they wish to continue operation beyond the expiry date.
